title: An explicit noncoordinate polynomial with affine three-space zero fibre
summary: We construct an explicit counterexample to the Abhyankar–Sathaye conjecture: a noncoordinate polynomial in four complex variables whose zero fibre is affine three-space. Adjoining variables gives counterexamples in every ambient dimension at least four.
family_title: A stable-coordinate counterexample in four variables

review.reason: Constructs an explicit noncoordinate polynomial counterexample to the Abhyankar-Sathaye conjecture.
